statements.t: We look forward to securing regulatory approval to close the acquisition of Disruptive Technologies (DT), which is expected before November 30, 2026.

Acquisitions remain a top capital priority for Digi as reflected by our definitive agreement, entered into on September 30, 2026, to acquire DT, a Norway-based provider of advanced sensing technology, for $130 million in cash, which we expect to fund using our existing revolving credit facility.
We will continue to be disciplined in our approach and act when we believe an opportunity is appropriate to execute in the context of prevailing market conditions.

The performance we are reporting today, and our outlook for fiscal 2027, reflect the benefits of this model, which insulates our margin structure in ways purely hardware-dependent businesses cannot match.
ARR growth, margin expansion, and customer retention trends all reinforce our confidence in achieving $200 million in both ARR and Adjusted EBITDA within our targeted time horizon.
For fiscal 2027, we anticipate ARR growth of at least 15% versus fiscal 2026.
We provide guidance or longer-term targets for adjusted net income per diluted share and Adjusted EBITDA, each on a non-GAAP basis.
